claims.sentence: We hypothesized that patients with type 1 diabetes might need higher doses of aspirin than the recommended low dose (75mg) treatment to gain effects on fibrin network permeability, and that the effects of aspirin treatment on fibrin network in these patients are influenced by the glycemic control.
